population: Single-resource scaffolding in the study's small Python HTTP application. The curator's reviewed executable accepts one new lowercase resource name and exactly three named fields: one string, one integer, and one boolean. Existing-resource edits, authorization, persistence changes, multiple resources, other schemas, extra operations, and requests to run a test command are outside this executable's declared capability. The reusable dispatch API retains arbitrary canonical tool schemas.
baseline: Two successful real host-agent sessions on separate copies of the same frozen application, followed by the ordinary curator, review, and promotion path.
artifact: A Harn tool that creates a resource module, request tests, and API documentation; validates inputs and project preconditions before writing; refuses existing targets; returns canonical mutation and fresh postcondition receipts.

allowed_changes: applicability threshold selected on development evidence
development.selector_screening: Three instruction revisions were screened on all 16 development requests with three live decision calls each before execution qualification. Revision 2 at an applicability threshold of 0.8 accepted 20 of 24 supported trials and none of 24 incompatible trials. These are selection observations, not completed execution trials or held-out qualification.
development.selection_rule: Prefer zero wrong accepted executions, then higher supported-request coverage, then lower measured provider cost and end-to-end latency. Record every attempted revision.

qualification.freeze: Freeze candidate source, selector and binder configuration, project files, independent grader, and all labeled requests before the first qualification call. Development cases never enter the qualification report. Do not tune against qualification labels.
qualification.interpretation: A bounded prototype qualification on this declared corpus, not a production accuracy claim or proof that synthetic cases are IID deployment traffic. Insufficient accepted execution evidence leaves the capability unqualified.

execution.workspace: One isolated workspace per trial, initialized from the frozen application. Never substitute historical receipts for execution.
execution.independent_grader: Run the application's real request path. Check successful creation and retrieval, every declared field and field type, rejection of invalid payloads, preservation of the original application, expected generated tests and documentation, and no unexpected source mutations. Negative cases must fall back before any learned-workflow mutation. The ordinary agent may then execute the requested task; report that work separately. Source census excludes Python caches and Harn and host runtime metadata, whose package and launcher identities are checked separately.
failure_controls: change after selection and before execution
stop or steer before a consequential tool call
tool mutation followed by failed verification, with recovery from actual history

inference.route_reason: The native Vercel route returned applied per-request no-training and zero-retention controls. The OpenRouter alpha-decision route was refused before dispatch because Harn has no verified no-training contract for that endpoint; its refusal was retained rather than weakening the inference boundary.
inference.baseline_and_curator_route: Resolve an ordinary capable coding route from the current host catalog and record the served identity.
inference.accounting: Retain physical provider-call and decision receipts, source identities, per-phase timings, actual tool calls and terminal state. Report unpriced calls separately; unknown spend is never zero.

publication: Run the local source-revision-pinned registered host consumer before creating feature PRs or publishing a release. Repeat packaging and affected checks when artifact identity changes.
